blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) on Tuesday called on private companies to implement and conduct precautionary measures to ensure workers are safe from the threat of poor air quality. Under Labor Advisory No. 15, Series of 2026, signed on Sept. 18, employers must apply workplace control measures, including those in the private sector and establishments that operate in elevated levels of air pollutants. “The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) urges private sector employers to take proactive measures to shield workers from environmental hazards when poor air quality threatens public health,” the Dole stated in a […]...
